checks.description: Reviewed the report HP3 friction/noise robustness screen and claim-a9ac9685183a4e3fb89ceff5a9664e8b at source revision 5bb8eb955fa680ddc631b6fb10f988ec3efb497a. Inspected manifest.json and the empty candidate.diff. All 32 submitted asset hashes match the manifest. This is a report-only submission with no production code candidate.

Traced the declared worlds, commands, effective 12-iteration override, fixed radii, zero buildup, native artifact and policy freeze. Rehashed the three embedded frozen policy sources and matched them to both v2 run invocations. The 09:44:12 freeze precedes the 10:03:13 eval0 start. The policy diff changes two preload paths plus import resolution. Inspected the generator and recorded byte-equivalence results; did not rerun generation or numerical jobs.

Parsed the exact applied M669 commands and independently recalculated Euclidean errors against the evaluator's full-precision authored truth. Maximum errors are 3.840677, 3.873242 and 4.349453 mm; anchor RMSE values are 3.284983, 3.319754 and 3.562306 mm. All match the saved measurements. Counted 140 points in each accepted dataset and recalculated nominal policy/default step ratio 0.9927558. These are arithmetic checks on saved data, not independent calibration reproduction.

Compared failure windows, partial-point evidence, manifests and hash-matched original collector logs. Active dev1 default has no points or fit; both development policy versions have 20 points and no fit; eval0 default has 40 points and no fit. Logs record encoder stability failures. Successful logs confirm spread-consensus stopping at iteration 5/12. Inspected severe 2693.972 and 2628.269 mm intermediate cold candidates separately from the final applied consensuses.

Inspected native readback of all nine guide coefficients, unchanged spool/motor settings, shared artifact identity and matched eval0 scene, noise sigma and seed. The posthoc noise-only control has zero native guide mu and normal acceptance. Zero-mu injection and unmodified nominal audits record the same complete first-step state hash. Saved native audits support the intervention distinction; no fresh audit was run.

Inspected probe construction, terminal snapshots and both saved native outputs. At 8 seconds the active probe has 53.494/53.353 mm local slack, zero local force and 0.0507058 Nm native load torque. Recalculated torque from transferred forces times 0.03 m radius, signed cable power 0.0133865 W, and rest/storage balances. Verified every source-map file hash and excerpt against git revision 5bb8eb955fa680ddc631b6fb10f988ec3efb497a. Source supports unconditional neighboring pinhole load transfer and the stated active-friction redistribution branch. No simulation, fit, exact replay or full energy audit was performed.

limitations: The evidence supports the tested simulation outcomes. It does not establish a hardware failure rate, calibrated hardware friction distribution or general robustness.
There is one completed nominal pair and one posthoc matched noise-only contrast. Adaptive workloads share a noise-stream prefix, not identical noise at identical physical times.
Held-out policy arms, eval1, wider friction ranges, layering, buildup and other machine configurations remain untested.

The probe reconstructs selected terminal fields with fresh hidden history. Terminal snapshots follow cleanup, and signed power samples omit terms required for a full energy balance. The complete causal model defect remains unresolved.
Independent work here checked saved-data arithmetic, hashes, commands and source. It did not independently reproduce the producer's numerical runs or reprocess every large raw sensor journal.
practical_value: The negative result prevents advancing an unsupported preload robustness claim. It preserves good nominal final accuracy and identifies a concrete guide transport and spool-load assumption for a separately scoped physical-model investigation.
reason: Keep the unchanged report and evidence. Its scoped claim is supported: bounded preload preserved nominal final errors below 5 mm but failed to recover the tested development collection; matched zero-guide/noise-only collection succeeded; the constructed native probe demonstrates load torque with macroscopic local slack. The report distinguishes intermediate fits from final acceptance and states the remaining causal and hardware limits. No production change is proposed, so code adoption and engineering gates are outside this report-only verdict.
